title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters
description: Uncover the profound significance and uncertain future of our rivers.

title: African Babies: Born Wild - Babies of the Plains
description: Waking up with a new generation of lion cubs, zebra calves, and hyena pups on the African savannah, where every sunrise brings hope and new challenges; celebrating their first strides toward independence in a land where every step is a test of survival.

title: Animals Like Us
description: The toothy fish that help sharks maintain their pearly whites; the signature calls of dolphin families; the capuchin monkey's nut-cracking stone tools; snuggling giraffes; a meerkat mobster.

title: Battle of the Alphas
description: Warthogs' lumpy armor, giant African bullfrogs' jumping and biting skills, wild turkeys' sharp beaks and razorlike spurs, and Nile crocodiles' powerful jaws.

title: Battle of the Alphas
description: A glacial stroll alongside a Galápagos tortoise; dancing with venomous European adders; a battle between Lacerta lizards; leopard seals' stealth attacks.

title: Wild Rose Vet
description: Brooke demonstrates the ever-important job of vet techs as she helps a dog named Charlie who was injured in a dogfight; Dr. Savannah treats a dog who was kicked by a horse; Brooke and Savannah then head over to a spay and neuter clinic in Sturgeon Lake.

title: Wild Rose Vet
description: A farm dog named Wrangler was run over by a tractor; a foal named Missy ripped her eyelid on a barbed wire fence; Savannah heads to the Enoch Cree Nation to run an emergency Parvo clinic.

title: Airborne
description: Each species evolves unique tools to outpace rivals in the eat-or-be-eaten game, taking to the skies is the ultimate advantage.

title: Airborne
description: Almost all the species that inhabit the Earth seek out mates to ensure the survival of their kind through reproduction; but while some mate for life, others live in fleeting moments.

title: Airborne
description: All airborne creatures embark on remarkable journeys through the air; some routes are short and others span across hundreds of miles.

title: Europe's Wild Kingdom
description: The series examines the connection between human history and nature by visiting notable landmarks across the continent.

title: Europe's Wild Kingdom
description: Witness animal drama among Europe's most dramatic peaks; visit medieval castles in Romania and France where bears, lynx and falcons are making a comeback; check out a rock lizard that's cleverly adapting to climate change in the Pyrenees.

title: Wild Science
description: Tracing the lion's rise from prehistoric predator to modern ruler as science reveals the battles, bonds, and brutal survival strategies that have shaped this iconic African hunter; getting swept up in the drama of lion society and high-risk hunts.

title: Big Cats: Nine Lives
description: Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

title: Planet Weird
description: Discover how weirdness is baked into some animals' DNA from birth; check out the bowerbird's mate-attracting dance moves, the Christmas Island crab's traffic-dodging prowess and the sockeye salmon's uphill swimming skills.

title: Planet Weird
description: A look at the supercharged abilities that give some animals an edge in life; discovering fireflies' flirty flashes, the tarsier's incredible night vision, the mantis shrimp' knockout punch and the saltwater croc's prey-detecting pressure sensors.

title: Coral City
description: Discover a city lying beneath the waves, where commuters flood the coral reef's main highways.

title: Coral City
description: Feel the heat of summer's arrival as supersize sea snails try to fend off an invading gang of coral-hungry starfish; accompany reef sharks as they prowl for a midnight meal and marvel at the slippery disguise a parrotfish uses to survive the night.

title: Coral City
description: Adapt or perish in the coral streets as higher-than-normal temperatures make autumn cooling more difficult; shack up with a clownfish family and their sea anemone landlord, then see cleaner fish give manta rays a day at the spa.

title: Coral City
description: Get chills as winter descends, slowing down life on the bustling reef; meander with reef sharks and octopuses, visit a coral oasis atop an old shipwreck, and spot a banded snake eel's talent for identity theft when it disguises itself as a predator.

title: Life in the Air
description: With the help of some surprising creatures from around the world, we'll discover how animals take to the air, defying the force all airborne animals must conquer - gravity.

title: Life in the Air
description: We are up and away with the world of powered flight - revealing why peregrine falcons can top 200 miles an hour, how a hummingbird is a slave to its own rather manic lifestyle, and that the albatross's secret to flying for free... is its nose!
